_comment: GitHub Repository Ruleset — Target Configuration for main branch protection.
_note: This file DESCRIBES the required ruleset. A repository admin must activate it via GitHub Settings → Rules → Rulesets. This file alone does not enforce protection.
_activation: Settings → Rules → Rulesets → New ruleset → Import from JSON or configure manually per the spec below.
name: Zamorin Café ERP — Main Branch Protection

bypass_actors._description: Repository admin only — no other bypass actors

rules._description: All changes must go through a pull request before merge
All CI checks must pass before merge is permitted

required_status_checks._covers: Backend regression + Stage 10 suite + Frontend router + master system verification
render.yaml, vercel.json, blueprint syntax, module integrity

rules._description: Prevent force-push to main — history must remain immutable
Prevent accidental deletion of the main branch
Require signed commits on main (where plan permits)

ci_yml_jobs: Run Backend Regression Test Suite (cross-system, durability, ASVS, stage10)

_enforcement_verification.instruction: A repository admin must navigate to: GitHub → Repository → Settings → Rules → Rulesets → New ruleset, and configure per the spec above. The active ruleset ID should be recorded here once activated.
